CHAPTER.VERS: O thoughtless, Galatians, who you deluded? to whom with respect to eyes Jesus Anointed was before set forth among you having been crucified.
This thing only I wish to have learned from you; on account of works of law the spirit did you receive, or on account of a hearing of faith?
So thoughtless are you? having begun in spirit, now in flesh are you being made perfect?
So many things you suffered without cause? If indeed even without cause.
The then supplying to you the spirit, and working miracles among you, on account of works of law, or on account of obedience of faith?
even as Abraham believed in the God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.
Know you certainly, that those of faith, these are sons of Abraham.

So that those of faith, are blessed with the believing Abraham.

As many as for of works of law are, under a curse they are; it has been written for: That accursed every one who not continues in all things those having been written in the book of the law, of the to have done them.

the but law not is of faith; but the one having done these things, shall live by them. Galatians
Anointed us bought off from the curse of the law, having become on behalf of us a curse; (it has been written for: Accursed every one he being hung on a tree;)
so that for the nations the blessing of the Abraham might be in Anointed Jesus, that the annunciation of the spirit we might receive through the faith.
Brethren, according to man I speak; though of a man having been ratified a covenant no one sets aside or superadds.
To the now Abraham were spoken the promises, even for the seed of him. Not he says: And to the seeds as concerning many, but as concerning one. And to the seed of thee; who is Anointed.
This but I say; a covenant previously ratified by the God concerning Anointed, that after four hundred and thirty years having become a law not annuls, so as the to have canceled the promise;
if for by law the inheritance, no longer by promise; to the but Abraham through promise has freely given the God.

Why then the law? The transgressions on account of it was appointed, (to which time should have come the seed, to whom it has been promised,) having been instituted by means of messengers, in hand of mediator.
The but mediator of one not he is; the but God one is.
The then law contrary to the promises of the God? Not let it be. If for was given a law that being able to have made alive, truly by law was the righteousness;
but shut up together the scripture the all things under sin, in order that the promise by faith of Jesus Anointed might be given to the believers.
Before the but to have come the faith, under law we were guarded being shut up together for the being about faith to have been revealed.

having come but the faith, no longer under a childleader we are. Galatians

as many as for into Anointed were dipped, Anointed you were clothed.
